scene: INT. MUNICIPAL OFFICE - NIGHT. A detective crosses a tired 1980s open office dressed as a police station: low acoustic ceiling, fluorescent fixtures and a clear 12-metre sightline between desks. We need at least 180 square metres in New York, parking for 3 production trucks and 30 crew cars.

INT. SMALL ACCOUNTANT'S OFFICE - DAWN. A lone worker opens the blinds in a 1960s office with two private rooms off a narrow corridor. The main room can be about 45 square metres; a modest ceiling is fine. New York location, one van and 6 crew cars.

INT. EXECUTIVE OFFICE - LATE AFTERNOON. A founder rehearses a resignation in a contemporary corner office with large windows and room for a wide two-shot. Seek roughly 80 square metres in New York and space outside for 2 trucks and 12 cars.

INT. NEWSROOM FLOOR - DAY. A reporter threads through crowded desks in a late-1990s open-plan office. We need 350 square metres, a ceiling above 3 metres and a long aisle for a tracking shot in New York. Parking for 4 trucks and 25 cars.

INT. EMPTY OFFICE FLOOR - NIGHT. Two siblings argue across an unfurnished contemporary open-plan floor. Concrete columns and a broad, uninterrupted view should support a 24mm wide shot covering 8 metres. At least 250 square metres in New York; 2 trucks, 15 cars.

INT. CALL CENTRE - EARLY MORNING. A cleaner finds a ringing telephone among low cubicles on a 1980s office floor. A drop ceiling and worn institutional finishes are useful. Around 220 square metres in New York; one truck and 10 crew cars.

INT. OFFICE LOBBY - EVENING. A courier waits beneath a large clock while office workers leave. Seek a 1970s lobby in New York, at least 100 square metres, with a reception counter and a 10-metre view toward the entrance. Parking for 2 trucks and 18 cars.

INT. MODERN BUILDING LOBBY - DAY. A security guard quietly stops a visitor near a glass entrance. A bright contemporary lobby with a ceiling over 4 metres and room to frame both actors full length is preferred. New York; 3 trucks and 20 cars.

INT. VACANT NEIGHBOURHOOD SHOP - DUSK. A family hangs a hand-painted opening sign in a small storefront dressed for 1985. Around 70 square metres, a street-facing window and a plain back wall suit the scene. New York; one truck and 8 crew cars.

INT. FORMER DEPARTMENT STORE - NIGHT. A watchman follows a sound across an empty sales floor. We need a large 1960s retail interior, at least 500 square metres with a 15-metre clear camera view, in New York. Loading access and parking for 5 trucks and 30 cars.

INT. WAREHOUSE - PRE-DAWN. A dock worker spots a bicycle between stacked crates. Seek an older brick industrial building in New York with a 5-metre ceiling, at least 400 square metres and visible loading doors. Parking for 4 trucks and 15 crew cars.

INT. CLEAN DISTRIBUTION UNIT - DAY. A manager tours a nearly empty contemporary warehouse. A broad concrete floor, 6-metre ceiling and 20-metre sightline are useful; target 900 square metres in New York. Need parking for 6 production trucks and 25 cars.

INT. PREWAR APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - MORNING. An elderly tenant shares breakfast with her grandson. Seek a New York apartment built before 1940, with a 30-square-metre living room, tall windows and space for a small dining table. One van and 5 crew cars; no production trucks.

INT. COMPACT APARTMENT - NIGHT. Two roommates whisper beside a kitchen doorway in a modest 1990s New York flat. A 20-square-metre living room and an ordinary ceiling work; the scene should feel cramped. Zero trucks, 4 crew cars and a short equipment walk.

INT. LOFT APARTMENT - SUNSET. A dancer clears furniture for one last rehearsal in a converted industrial loft. At least 90 square metres and a 3.5-metre ceiling, with a long wall and large windows, in New York. Parking for 2 trucks and 10 crew cars.

INT. LAW FIRM OFFICE - DAY. A junior lawyer waits outside a partner's door in a polished 2000s workplace. Seek a 120-square-metre New York office suite with a meeting room visible from the corridor. Parking for 2 trucks and 14 cars.

INT. STARTUP OFFICE - NIGHT. Three colleagues take down launch decorations on an open office floor. Contemporary finishes, at least 160 square metres and a 9-metre camera path are preferred in New York. Parking for 3 trucks and 16 crew cars.

INT. AGING APARTMENT LOBBY - DAWN. A resident waits for an elevator while a caretaker mops. Seek a modest pre-1970 lobby in New York, roughly 50 square metres, with an entry door visible from the lift area. One truck and 7 crew cars.

INT. EMPTY SHOWROOM - LATE AFTERNOON. A salesperson practices a pitch to an absent customer. A 1990s retail showroom in New York, at least 200 square metres with broad front windows and a 3-metre ceiling, suits the scene. Parking for 3 trucks and 18 cars.

INT. SMALL WORKSHOP WAREHOUSE - NIGHT. A mechanic switches off the last task light in a 1970s industrial unit. Around 180 square metres, a 4-metre ceiling and a roll-up door are preferred in New York. Need parking for 2 trucks and 8 cars.
